description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Coordinated with PDP-Connect/data-connect#63. The npm dependency updates change both runtime/protocol package manifests, so the 0.0.1 archives and their lockfile integrity records are refreshed from this SHA. data-connect-1-0-0.note: A SEPARATE, later data-connect SHA used ONLY by the 1.0.0 half of drift job (c) tarball-digests — deliberately NOT the same value as the `data-connect` pin above. pdpp's vendor/SHA256SUMS (see pdpp's vendor/README.md 'Current 1.0.0 release-boundary pins') records pdpp-collector-runtime-1.0.0.tgz / pdpp-connector-protocol-1.0.0.tgz packed from data-connect PR #36's tree — this is PR #36's merge commit into main ('Add local collection and release checks', merged 2026-09-02T07:53:00Z), superseding the prior 10f25a3cd6 pin which recorded the PR's pre-merge head commit. Confirmed via `git diff 10f25a3cd6..b70dda89a -- packages/collector-runtime packages/connector-protocol scripts/pin-collector-runtime-protocol-dependency.ts` (empty — the merge is a true two-parent merge of the reviewed branch, not a squash, so the packages this pin backs are byte-identical between the two commits; the merge additionally picked up an unrelated repo-wide SPDX-header sweep and other main-tip drift, none of it touching these paths) that the previously-vendored 1.0.0 tarballs still reconcile: no re-vendor needed, this is a SHA-reference-only update. This SHA is NOT used for jobs (a)/(b) or the 0.0.1 tarball repack: data-connect's local-collector/collector-runtime/connector-protocol sources changed materially between the `data-connect` pin above and this one (STREAM_EVIDENCE outcomes-partition wire change, capability-array validation, package-artifact receipts), so reusing this SHA for the shared `data-connect` pin would flip jobs (a)/(b) and the 0.0.1 repack from passing to failing — those still compare against data-connectors' and pdpp's committed 0.0.1 artifacts, which were packed from the OLDER `data-connect` pin and have not been repinned to 1.0.0 themselves. Revisit consolidating these two pins into one only once data-connectors' own packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/ moves off 0.0.1.
